meta.facing: single front (camera-facing) view, sword on the viewer's left. Mirror horizontally when moving/attacking to the viewer's right; use the same frames for up/down. No back view yet.
meta.anchor: draw at (feetX - footX, feetY - footY); footY 41 = feet anchor row (same anchor as the scene hero). Ring is NOT in the frames: GD draws the live ring (halo + cream stroke) before the hero.
meta.unarmed: core uses hero_bare_* when no weapon is equipped (empty fists, no sword, no shield; unarmed max hit 1). Same cell, anchor and mirroring as hero_rustbound_*.
